data.title: bn-1ez: deterministic fixture decoys and session expiry
data.description: Adds isolated login-page, stale-snapshot, 403-body exposure, recent-canary echo and session-expiring report route families. Extends established same-subject session evidence with a private invoice read. Original four flaw switches and policy routes are unchanged. Decoy tests exercise ordered HTTP requests, exact response bodies/status/headers, all-off/all-on switch configurations, app/reset isolation, bounded echo history and session-local target-driven expiry. Full just check passed (28 tests). Public operator modes remain bn-189; ground-truth packaging remains bn-2ag. Self-review recorded on the bone.
